model_annotation: The plot illustrates how coverage changes as the number of completions \(k\) increases for four model/setting variants. The x-axis is labeled “Number of completions (\(k\))” and is shown with discrete tick labels at powers of two from \(2^0\) through \(2^8\) (i.e., \(k=1\) to \(k=256\)), with one tick per successive power of two. The y-axis is labeled “Coverage” on a linear scale, spanning roughly from about 0.2 up to just over 0.9, with labeled ticks at 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8. The “Llama-3B” series is drawn as a dark blue solid line with circular markers, increasing from about 0.43 at \(2^0\) to about 0.90 by \(2^8\), with intermediate points near 0.62 at \(2^2\), ~0.78 at \(2^4\), and ~0.86–0.87 at \(2^6\). The “Llama-3B + FT” series is drawn in green with triangle markers and a dotted/dashed line style, rising from about 0.45 at \(2^0\) to about 0.91 at \(2^8\), passing through approximately 0.63 at \(2^2\), ~0.78 at \(2^4\), and ~0.87 at \(2^6\). The “Llama-1B” series appears as a lighter blue solid line with circular markers, increasing from about 0.25 at \(2^0\) to about 0.86 at \(2^8\), with representative values around 0.45 at \(2^2\), ~0.64 at \(2^4\), and ~0.79–0.80 at \(2^6\). The “Llama-1B + FT” series is shown in a pale green with triangle markers and a dotted/dashed line style, rising from about 0.25 at \(2^0\) to about 0.88 at \(2^8\), with intermediate values near 0.45 at \(2^2\), ~0.64 at \(2^4\), and ~0.82 at \(2^7\).
